body:
That would be a lot more difficult because inline snapshots rely on Prettier, file system and custom parsers.

You can learn more in the [original inline snapshots thread](https://github.com/facebook/jest/pull/6380) and in the [Jest source code](https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/f206afbda05b3b248a33376afe51b28170056bff/packages/jest-snapshot/src/inline_snapshots.ts).

I'm not aware of any helper for that.

I would suggest sticking with regular expectations.
